sections.title: **Chief Complaint:**
sections.text: Sudden onset of intense chest pain radiating to the left arm, accompanied by shortness of breath and dizziness.

sections.title: **Clinical Observations:**
sections.text:
- Vitals: BP 165/110 mmHg, Pulse 102 bpm, Temp 98.2°F 

- ECG shows ST-segment elevation 

- Patient appears pale and diaphoretic 

- Oxygen saturation: 89%

sections.title: **Preliminary Diagnosis:**
sections.text: Acute Myocardial Infarction (Heart Attack) — STEMI type

sections.title: **Recommendations:**
sections.text:
1. Immediate transfer to cardiac ICU 

2. Administer aspirin (325 mg) and initiate oxygen therapy 

3. Prepare for emergency angiography and possible PCI 

4. Monitor cardiac enzymes (Troponin, CK-MB) 

5. Continuous ECG monitoring and IV nitroglycerin if BP allows 

**Physician:** Dr. Emily Roberts **Date:** 2025-04-08

# **Patient Name:** David Miller 

**Age:** 62 **Gender:** Male 

# **Chief Complaint:** 

Sudden onset of intense chest pain radiating to the left arm, accompanied by shortness of breath and dizziness. 

# **Clinical Observations:** 

- Vitals: BP 165/110 mmHg, Pulse 102 bpm, Temp 98.2°F 

- ECG shows ST-segment elevation 

- Patient appears pale and diaphoretic 

- Oxygen saturation: 89% 

# **Preliminary Diagnosis:** 

Acute Myocardial Infarction (Heart Attack) — STEMI type 

# **Recommendations:** 

1. Immediate transfer to cardiac ICU 

2. Administer aspirin (325 mg) and initiate oxygen therapy 

3. Prepare for emergency angiography and possible PCI 

4. Monitor cardiac enzymes (Troponin, CK-MB) 

5. Continuous ECG monitoring and IV nitroglycerin if BP allows 

**Physician:** Dr. Emily Roberts **Date:** 2025-04-08
